blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19 at HyperEVM block 48936367 (2026-10-19T06:20:04Z). USDM is the sole catalogued deployment at 100% of 2,924,098.61 supply. Proxy 0xe2d2959f89b6389deb624bf076fe7d9e5401f377 resolves to implementation 0x05faf9cfa7143804e7fb0db423fde8330cd586df; paused()=false and vault()=0x5586c2c8223c73ec0b41d6352748e6c173372e11. The verified implementation has no per-address blacklist, freeze, seizure or arbitrary-holder burn: mint/burn are onlyVault and burn is self-only. It exposes pause()/unpause() onlyGuardian and UUPS upgrades gated by the ACL UPGRADER role. The 48-hour TimelockController 0xDe54E1F99752062ef448Dcc6C7636f90214C789e held UPGRADER at the pin, so the implementation can be replaced by an active administrator; the global pause is a further system-wide transfer control. Under the FreezeWatch decision procedure (docs/blacklist-tracker.md), these are direct Possible, not Yes. Reserve composition is a single unreconciled protocol-position row and is not used.

oracleRisk.summary: USDM's live MonetrixAccountant values strategy spot and supplied positions through HyperCore's oracle-price precompile at 0x807. Hyperliquid documents three-second validator submissions and a stake-weighted median of submitted prices; each validator aggregates configured exchange prices. At HyperEVM block 47461225, the vault-linked accountant resolves to the exact verified implementation 0x5ce5e40522e8cb42d7a1ae2dadab808d31f1a8e2. Its PrecompileReader rejects failed, short or zero oracle responses. No independent fallback or separate delay is established, and Hyperliquid remains the common venue/oracle dependency.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDM has no borrower-specific collateral or liquidation branches. Its current vault-linked accountant uses HyperCore oracle prices for protocol-wide backing valuation through spot and supplied-position readers. The live accounting path, verified implementation and native oracle documentation establish the top-level price authority; independent failover is not claimed.
